title: SimBrief Fuel Reserve Margin by Route Type
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simbrief:plan route_type=* reserve_margin_min=*
| stats avg(reserve_margin_min) as avg_reserve_margin_min, count as events by route_type
| sort - avg_reserve_margin_min
description: Shows average fuel reserve margin minutes by route type for flight-plan reserve tracking.
value: Average fuel reserve margin minutes by route type helps compare flight-plan reserve tracking across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `reserve_margin_min` on `simbrief:plan` events and normalize `route_type` so Splunk can summarize performance by route type.
visualization: Bar chart of average fuel reserve margin minutes by route type.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors the average fuel reserve margin minutes for each route type so you can see what works best for flight-plan reserve tracking.
